import logging

import requests

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def sign_up(db, name, email, birth_date):
    log.info('new user %s %s born %s', name, email, birth_date)
    db.insert('users', {'name': name, 'email': email, 'birth_date': birth_date})
    requests.post('https://analytics.example.com/events', json={'event': 'sign_up', 'email': email}, timeout=5)
